name: bug-enclosed-cutout
bug_comment: Demonstrates the fully-enclosed-cutout known issue. The plate slab spans z 2..10; the solid strip between key holes runs along x=9.525. 'buried (bug)' sits wholly inside that material and removes nothing at all, silently. 'through (control)' breaks both surfaces and cuts correctly.

cutouts.name: buried (bug)
cutouts.comment: sphere r=2 at mid-slab, touching no surface - should remove 33.5mm3, removes 0

cutouts.name: through (control)
cutouts.comment: same strip, but passes right through - cuts correctly
